'''Dantora''' is an island belonging to the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' and is part of the [[Aile Jafar]] group.

==Activities==
After leaving [[Tanchico]], the ''Atha'an Miere'' ship ''[[Wavedancer]]'' planned to sail to Dantora and then on to [[Cantorin]] and the [[Aile Somera]] group.{{ref/book|4|39}} After learning of the ''[[Coramoor]]'', they also spread the word of his rebirth to those islands.{{ref/book|4|46}}
